"""E-003, finish line 1: a reader signs in with GitHub from a report and lands back on it (a return target off this
site lands home); votes count once per reader per report, can be changed or withdrawn, are refused to visitors and
to requests from other sites; the dislike count reaches no one but the pinned owner, who sees it for each report.

A visitor follows the report page's 'Sign in with GitHub' link, which carries the return target as a query parameter
naming /reports/<slug>, and the stand-in GitHub approves them; the same link is then followed with its target swapped
for addresses that are not paths on this site. Readers vote through POST /reports/<slug>/vote (vote=up, down or none,
sent from the report page, which offers that form); everyone reads the like count on the report page and the home
page, and the owner reads each report's dislike count on its admin view, /admin/reports/<slug>. Every answer served to
a visitor and to the readers after the last dislikes are cast is searched for a dislike count: a 2 or a 3 beside a
dislike label, in its text or its markup.

How it runs: `go build ./cmd/hband`, started on a free port with a fresh data folder and the HBAND_* settings in
Product, spoken to as the VPS proxy forwards a browser, with a stand-in GitHub of its own. Every POST carries the CSRF
token of the page it is sent from (a hidden field named like csrf/xsrf/token, or a csrf meta tag as X-CSRF-Token); a
count is a number beside its label ("3 likes", "Likes: 3", a thumb and 3).
"""
import base64, glob, html.parser, http.client, json, os, re, secrets, shutil, socket, subprocess, sys, tempfile, threading
import time, unittest, warnings
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from urllib.parse import parse_qsl, urlencode, urljoin, urlsplit

warnings.simplefilter("ignore")  # a failure speaks by its message: a traceback or warning would open this file to quote it
threading.excepthook, sys.excepthook = (lambda a: None), (lambda k, v, tb: print(f"{k.__name__}: {v}", file=sys.stderr))
[s.reconfigure(errors="backslashreplace") for s in (sys.stdout, sys.stderr)]
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))
BASE, EVIL, EXE, OWNER_ID = "https://hband.test", "https://evil.example", ".exe" if os.name == "nt" else "", 4242
UA = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/131.0 Safari/537.36"


def check(ok, why):
    if not ok:
        raise AssertionError(why)


def mark(word):  # letters only, so no count is ever read into it
    return word + "-" + "".join(secrets.choice("bcdfghjkmnpqrstvwxz") for _ in range(10))


def build(work):  # the product: what `go build ./cmd/hband` makes of this tree
    go = [g for g in (shutil.which("go"), os.path.join(os.environ.get("GOROOT") or "-", "bin", "go" + EXE),
                      r"C:\Program Files\Go\bin\go.exe", *glob.glob(os.path.expanduser("~/sdk/go*/bin/go" + EXE))) if g and os.path.isfile(g)]
    check(go, "no Go toolchain (PATH, GOROOT, Program Files, ~/sdk) to build ./cmd/hband with")
    run = subprocess.run([go[0], "build", "-o", work + "/hband" + EXE, "./cmd/hband"], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True,
                         errors="replace", env=dict(os.environ, CGO_ENABLED="0"), timeout=780)
    check(run.returncode == 0, f"`go build ./cmd/hband` exited {run.returncode}: {(run.stdout + run.stderr)[:2000]}")
    return [work + "/hband" + EXE]


class GitHub(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):  # stand-in GitHub: a code the test handed out buys a token, the token its account (/user)
    log_message = lambda self, *a: None

    def answer(self, status, body, kind="application/json"):
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", kind)
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body.encode())

    def do_POST(self):
        sent = self.rfile.read(int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)).decode() + "&" + urlsplit(self.path).query
        who, token, js = self.server.codes.pop(dict(parse_qsl(sent)).get("code"), None), secrets.token_hex(16), "json" in self.headers.get("Accept", "")
        if who is None:
            return self.answer(400, '{"error": "bad_verification_code"}')
        self.server.tokens[token], got = who, {"access_token": token, "token_type": "bearer", "scope": ""}
        self.answer(200, json.dumps(got) if js else urlencode(got), "application/json" if js else "application/x-www-form-urlencoded")

    def do_GET(self):
        who = self.server.tokens.get((self.headers.get("Authorization") or "-").split()[-1])
        self.answer(200, json.dumps(dict(who, name=who["login"], type="User"))) if who else self.answer(401, '{"message": "Bad credentials"}')


class Node:
    def __init__(self, tag, attrs, parent):
        self.tag, self.attrs, self.parent, self.kids, self.data = tag, dict(attrs), parent, [], ""

    def walk(self):
        for k in self.kids:
            yield k
            yield from k.walk()

    def text(self, skip=lambda n: False):  # what it shows a person, less the elements `skip` names
        if self.tag == "#text":
            return self.data
        if self.tag in ("script", "style", "template", "textarea", "title") or skip(self):
            return ""
        return " ".join(" ".join(k.text(skip).split()) for k in self.kids).strip()


def dom(text):  # a page as a tree of elements and texts, forgiving of the end tags HTML leaves out
    at = [Node("#root", (), None)]

    class Reader(html.parser.HTMLParser):
        def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
            while len(at) > 1 and at[-1].tag == tag in ("li", "p", "tr", "td", "option"):
                at.pop()
            at[-1].kids.append(Node(tag, ((k, v or "") for k, v in attrs), at[-1]))
            if tag not in ("area", "base", "br", "col", "embed", "hr", "img", "input", "link", "meta", "source", "wbr"):
                at.append(at[-1].kids[-1])

        def handle_endtag(self, tag):
            while any(n.tag == tag for n in at[1:]) and at.pop().tag != tag:
                pass

        def handle_data(self, data):
            at[-1].kids.append(Node("#text", (), at[-1]))
            at[-1].kids[-1].data = data

    reader = Reader(convert_charrefs=True)
    reader.feed(text)
    reader.close()
    return at[0]


def chain(n):  # the node and every element around it
    return chain(n.parent) + [n] if n is not None else []


class Page:
    def __init__(self, url, r):
        self.url, self.status, self.msg, self.text, self._dom = url, r.status, r.msg, r.read().decode("utf-8", "replace"), None

    def header(self, name):
        return self.msg.get(name) or ""

    @property
    def dom(self):
        self._dom = self._dom or dom(self.text)
        return self._dom


def csrf(page):  # the page's CSRF token: hidden fields named like one, or a csrf meta tag (sent as X-CSRF-Token)
    hid = {n.attrs["name"]: n.attrs.get("value", "") for n in list(page.dom.walk())[::-1] if n.tag == "input"
           and n.attrs.get("type", "").lower() == "hidden" and re.search("csrf|xsrf|token", n.attrs.get("name", ""), re.I)}
    meta = [n.attrs.get("content", "") for n in page.dom.walk() if n.tag == "meta" and re.search("csrf|xsrf", n.attrs.get("name", ""), re.I)]
    return hid, ({"X-CSRF-Token": meta[0]} if meta else {})


class Browser:
    """A visitor as the VPS proxy forwards it (cookies, X-Forwarded-For, https, the public host); `seen`: every answer it got."""
    def __init__(self, port, login=None):
        self.port, self.login, self.jar, self.seen = port, login, {}, []

    def send(self, method, url, body=None, headers=None):
        u, c = urlsplit(urljoin(BASE + "/", url)), http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1", self.port, timeout=60)
        h = {"Host": u.netloc, "Accept": "text/html,*/*", "User-Agent": UA, "X-Forwarded-For": "192.0.2.10", "X-Real-IP": "192.0.2.10",
             "X-Forwarded-Proto": "https", **({"Cookie": "; ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in self.jar.items())} if self.jar else {}), **(headers or {})}
        try:
            c.request(method, (u.path or "/") + (f"?{u.query}" if u.query else ""), body, h)
            page = Page(u.geturl(), c.getresponse())
        finally:
            c.close()
        for line in page.msg.get_all("Set-Cookie") or []:
            name, _, value = line.split(";")[0].strip().partition("=")
            self.jar.pop(name, None)
            if value and not re.search(r"max-age=(0|-)|expires=[^;]*19[67]\d", line, re.I):
                self.jar[name] = value
        self.seen.append(page)
        return page

    def go(self, url, method="GET", body=None, headers=None):  # where the browser lands, after this site's own redirects
        page = self.send(method, url, body, headers)
        for _ in range(8):
            to = urljoin(page.url, page.header("Location"))
            if not (300 <= page.status < 400 and page.header("Location")) or urlsplit(to).netloc != "hband.test":
                break
            page = self.send("GET", to)
        return page

    def post(self, path, fields, page, forged=False):
        # a form POST with the CSRF token of `page`; `forged`: sent by another site, which sets no header of its own
        hid, meta = csrf(page)
        h = {"Origin": EVIL, "Referer": EVIL + "/", "Sec-Fetch-Site": "cross-site"} if forged else {
            "Origin": BASE, "Referer": page.url, "Sec-Fetch-Site": "same-origin", **meta}
        return self.go(path, "POST", urlencode({**hid, **fields}).encode(), {"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded", **h})


class Product:
    """The server this tree builds: a free port, a fresh data folder, a stand-in GitHub, the owner pinned by user ID."""
    def __init__(self):
        self.work, self.proc, self.hub = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="hband-acceptance-"), None, ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), GitHub)
        self.hub.codes, self.hub.tokens, self.hub.daemon_threads, self.hub.handle_error = {}, {}, True, lambda *a: None
        threading.Thread(target=self.hub.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
        self.url, self.log = f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.hub.server_address[1]}", open(self.work + "/server.log", "wb")
        self.owner = self.account(OWNER_ID, "report-author")
        try:
            command = build(self.work)
            with socket.socket() as s:
                s.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
                self.port = s.getsockname()[1]
            os.makedirs(self.work + "/data")
            self.proc = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=self.work, stdout=self.log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, env=dict(
                os.environ, HBAND_ADDR=f"127.0.0.1:{self.port}", HBAND_DATA_DIR=self.work + "/data", HBAND_BASE_URL=BASE,
                HBAND_OWNER_GITHUB_ID=str(OWNER_ID), HBAND_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID="hband-test", HBAND_GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET="hband-test-secret",
                HBAND_GITHUB_URL=self.url, HBAND_GITHUB_API_URL=self.url, HBAND_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES=str(10 << 20), HBAND_TRUSTED_PROXIES="127.0.0.1"))
            for _ in range(240):
                check(self.proc.poll() is None, f"the server exited ({self.proc.returncode}): {self.said()}")
                try:
                    Browser(self.port).send("GET", "/")
                    return
                except OSError:
                    time.sleep(0.25)
            check(False, f"the server did not answer in 60 s: {self.said()}")
        except BaseException:
            self.stop()
            raise

    def said(self):
        self.log.flush()
        with open(self.log.name, "rb") as fh:
            return fh.read()[-2000:].decode("utf-8", "replace")

    def stop(self):
        if self.proc and self.proc.poll() is None:
            self.proc.kill()
            self.proc.wait(30)
        self.log.close()
        self.hub.shutdown()
        self.hub.server_close()
        shutil.rmtree(self.work, ignore_errors=True)

    def account(self, uid, login=None):  # a GitHub account: user ID, login, avatar address
        return {"id": uid, "login": login or mark("reader").lower(), "avatar_url": f"https://avatars.example/u/{uid}?v=4"}

    def sign_in(self, who):  # a browser signed in through GitHub as `who`, from GET /auth/github/login
        b = Browser(self.port, who["login"])
        got = self.approve(b, b.send("GET", "/auth/github/login"), who)
        check(got.status < 400, f"signing in as {who['login']} landed on {got.status}: {got.text[:300]}")
        return b

    def approve(self, b, start, who):
        # GitHub's half of the sign-in `start` began (a redirect to its authorize page): it approves `who`; where `b` lands
        to = start.header("Location")
        check(300 <= start.status < 400 and to.startswith(self.url + "/login/oauth/authorize"),
              f"{start.url} answered {start.status} {to!r}, not a redirect to GitHub's authorize page")
        asked, code = dict(parse_qsl(urlsplit(to).query)), secrets.token_hex(10)
        self.hub.codes[code], back = who, asked.get("redirect_uri") or BASE + "/auth/github/callback"
        return b.go(back + ("&" if "?" in back else "?") + urlencode({"code": code, "state": asked.get("state", "")}))

    def publish(self, owner, slug, title):  # the owner uploads a report as the admin page's form does, published now
        hid, meta = csrf(owner.go("/admin"))
        edge, doc = secrets.token_hex(12), f"<!doctype html><html><head><title>{title}</title></head><body><h1>{title}</h1></body></html>"
        body = "".join(f'--{edge}\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name="{k}"\r\n\r\n{v}\r\n' for k, v in {
            **hid, "title": title, "slug": slug, "status": "published"}.items()) + f'--{edge}\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; ' \
            f'name="file"; filename="{slug}.html"\r\nContent-Type: text/html\r\n\r\n{doc}\r\n--{edge}--\r\n'
        got = owner.go("/admin/reports", "POST", body.encode(), {**meta, "Origin": BASE, "Referer": BASE + "/admin",
                                                                "Content-Type": f"multipart/form-data; boundary={edge}"})
        check(got.status < 400, f"publishing {slug} answered {got.status}: {got.text[:300]}")
        time.sleep(1.1)  # a second apart, so the newest is known


class Case(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.app = Product()
        self.addCleanup(self.app.stop)


LABELS = {"likes": r"likes?|thumbs?[ _-]?ups?|upvotes?|\U0001F44D", "dislikes": r"dislikes?|thumbs?[ _-]?downs?|downvotes?|\U0001F44E",
          "comments": r"comments?|\U0001F4AC", "opens": r"times opened|opened|opens?|views?"}
WORDS = re.compile("|".join(rf"(?P<{k}>(?<![^\W\d_])(?:{v})(?![^\W\d_]))" for k, v in LABELS.items()) + r"|(?P<num>\d+)|[^\W\d_]+")
BLOCKS = set("article aside br button dd div dl dt footer form h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 header hr label li main nav ol p section "
             "summary table td th tr ul".split())


def pieces(node):  # the texts a person reads apart: split at block elements, and at , ; | and middle dots
    out = [""]

    def visit(n):
        if n.tag == "#text":
            out[-1] += n.data
        elif n.tag not in ("script", "style", "template", "textarea", "title"):
            out.extend([""] if n.tag in BLOCKS else [])
            out[-1] += f" {n.attrs.get('aria-label', '')} {n.attrs.get('alt', '')} "
            [visit(k) for k in n.kids]
            out.extend([""] if n.tag in BLOCKS else [])
    visit(node)
    return [p for s in out for p in re.split(r"[,;|\u00b7\u2022\n]", s) if p.strip()]


def tally(text):  # each label's numbers in a piece: the number beside each label, on the side that reads more of them
    toks, best = [(m.lastgroup, m.group()) for m in WORDS.finditer(text.lower())], {}
    for side in (-1, 1):
        got, used = {}, set()
        for i, (kind, _) in enumerate(toks):
            j = i + side
            while kind and 0 <= j < len(toks) and toks[j][0] == kind:
                j += side
            if kind not in (None, "num") and 0 <= j < len(toks) and toks[j][0] == "num" and j not in used:
                used.add(j)
                got.setdefault(kind, set()).add(int(toks[j][1]))
        best = got if sum(map(len, got.values())) > sum(map(len, best.values())) else best
    return best


def counts(node):  # each label's numbers as `node` (a page's dom, or part of it) shows them
    out = {k: set() for k in LABELS}
    for p in pieces(node):
        for k, v in tally(p).items():
            out[k] |= v
    return out


def count(node, kind, where):  # the one `kind` count shown: a number beside its label ("3 likes", "Likes: 3", a thumb and 3)
    got = counts(node)[kind]
    check(len(got) == 1, f"{where} shows {kind} count(s) {sorted(got)}, not one number beside its label")
    return min(got)


def vote(b, slug, kind):  # POST /reports/<slug>/vote with vote=up|down|none, sent from the report page
    got = b.post(f"/reports/{slug}/vote", {"vote": kind}, b.go(f"/reports/{slug}"))
    check(got.status < 400, f"{b.login}'s vote {kind} on {slug} answered {got.status}: {got.text[:200]}")


def dislikes(owner, slug):  # the dislike count on the owner's admin view of the report, /admin/reports/<slug>
    return count(owner.go(f"/admin/reports/{slug}").dom, "dislikes", f"/admin/reports/{slug}")


def beside(page):  # every number next to a dislike label, on either side, in the page's text or in its markup
    found = set()
    for p in pieces(page.dom) + re.split(r"[,;|<>\n]", page.text):
        toks = [(m.lastgroup, m.group()) for m in WORDS.finditer(p.lower())]
        found |= {int(toks[j][1]) for i, t in enumerate(toks) if t[0] == "dislikes" for j in (i - 1, i + 1) if 0 <= j < len(toks) and toks[j][0] == "num"}
    return found


class E003SignInAndVoteTest(Case):
    def test_a_reader_signs_in_from_a_report_votes_once_per_report_from_this_site_only_and_only_the_owner_sees_dislikes(self):
        app, a, z = self.app, "e003-vote-older", "e003-vote-newest"
        owner = app.sign_in(app.owner)
        app.publish(owner, a, "Older Notes")
        app.publish(owner, z, "Newest Notes")
        who = app.account(7201)
        anon, r1 = Browser(app.port), Browser(app.port, who["login"])
        page = r1.go(f"/reports/{a}")
        links = [urljoin(page.url, n.attrs.get("href", "")) for n in page.dom.walk() if n.tag == "a" and re.search(
            r"sign\s*in\s+with\s+github", n.text() + " " + n.attrs.get("aria-label", ""), re.I)]
        self.assertTrue(links, f"/reports/{a} ({page.status}) has no 'Sign in with GitHub' link")
        query = parse_qsl(urlsplit(links[0]).query)
        key = next((k for k, v in query if urlsplit(v).path == f"/reports/{a}"), None)
        self.assertTrue(key, f"the sign-in link {links[0]} carries no return target naming /reports/{a}")
        landed = app.approve(r1, r1.go(links[0]), who)
        self.assertEqual((landed.status, re.split("[?#]", landed.url)[0]), (200, f"{BASE}/reports/{a}"),
                         f"signing in from the report landed on {landed.url} ({landed.status})")
        self.assertIn(who["login"], landed.dom.text(), "the report page does not show the reader signed in, by their GitHub login")
        for bad in ("https://evil.example/e003", "//evil.example/e003", "/\\evil.example/e003", "javascript:alert(1)"):
            b = Browser(app.port)
            aimed = urlsplit(links[0])._replace(query=urlencode([(k, bad if k == key else v) for k, v in query])).geturl()
            landed = app.approve(b, b.go(aimed), app.account(7209))
            self.assertEqual((landed.status, re.split("[?#]", landed.url)[0]), (200, BASE + "/"),
                             f"the return target {bad!r} landed on {landed.url} ({landed.status}) {landed.header('Location')}")
        r2, r3, r4 = [app.sign_in(app.account(7202 + i)) for i in range(3)]
        likes = lambda slug: count(anon.go(f"/reports/{slug}").dom, "likes", f"/reports/{slug}")
        self.assertIn(f"/reports/{z}/vote", r1.go(f"/reports/{z}").text, "the report page offers a signed-in reader no vote form")
        vote(r1, z, "up")
        self.assertEqual((likes(z), count(anon.go("/").dom, "likes", "/")), (1, 1), "one thumbs up, on the report page and the home page")
        vote(r1, z, "up")
        self.assertEqual(likes(z), 1, "pressing thumbs up again changed the like count")
        vote(r1, z, "down")
        self.assertEqual((likes(z), dislikes(owner, z)), (0, 1), "switching to thumbs down: no like, one dislike")
        vote(r1, z, "none")
        self.assertEqual((likes(z), dislikes(owner, z)), (0, 0), "withdrawing the vote: neither")
        vote(r1, a, "up"), vote(r2, a, "up"), vote(r1, z, "up")
        self.assertEqual((likes(a), likes(z)), (2, 1), "two readers' likes on one report, one reader's likes on two")
        for kind in ("up", "down"):  # a visitor who is not signed in, and another site sending r3's session with r4's token
            self.assertLess(anon.post(f"/reports/{a}/vote", {"vote": kind}, anon.go(f"/reports/{a}")).status, 500)
            self.assertLess(r3.post(f"/reports/{a}/vote", {"vote": kind}, r4.go(f"/reports/{a}"), forged=True).status, 500)
        self.assertEqual((likes(a), likes(z), dislikes(owner, a), dislikes(owner, z)), (2, 1, 0, 0), "a refused vote changed a count")
        vote(r2, a, "none"), vote(r1, z, "none")
        for b in (anon, r1, r2, r3, r4):
            b.seen.clear()
        for b, slug in ((r2, a), (r3, a), (r4, a), (r3, z), (r4, z)):
            vote(b, slug, "down")
        for b in (anon, r1, r2, r3, r4):
            for path in ("/", "/reports", f"/reports/{a}", f"/reports/{z}", "/admin", f"/admin/reports/{a}", f"/admin/reports/{z}"):
                b.go(path)
        leaks = [f"{p.url} ({p.status}) to {b.login or 'a visitor'}" for b in (anon, r1, r2, r3, r4) for p in b.seen if beside(p) & {2, 3}]
        self.assertFalse(leaks, f"a dislike count was shown to someone who is not the owner: {leaks[:4]}")
        self.assertEqual((likes(a), likes(z), dislikes(owner, a), dislikes(owner, z)), (1, 0, 3, 2), "each report's likes and the owner's dislikes")


class Plain(unittest.TextTestResult):  # a failure is told by its message alone
    _exc_info_to_string = lambda self, err, test: f"{err[0].__name__}: {err[1]}"


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(not unittest.TextTestRunner(resultclass=Plain, verbosity=2).run(
        unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromModule(sys.modules[__name__])).wasSuccessful())
